NYXEN PLAYER
A music player for Android

Music,
your way.

Nyxen Player is an Android music player designed to help you listen to and organize your music in one place, with a dark, minimal interface and playback tools built around your library.

What Nyxen Player does

Your music library

Browse and play supported audio files stored on your device, subject to the permissions you grant.

Playback controls

Use music-player features such as playlists, shuffle, repeat and audio controls where available in the installed version.

Google Sign-In

Where enabled, Google Sign-In lets you authenticate with your Google account. It is not required for ordinary local playback unless the app indicates otherwise.

Privacy and responsible use

We aim to request only the access needed for the features you choose to use. Nyxen Player is a music player; it is not designed to create, request, or distribute AI-generated non-consensual intimate imagery.

Read our Privacy Policy to understand what information the app handles, why it is used, and what choices you have. You can also read our Terms of Service.
